formalDefinition: Feedback Node Set = {<G,k> | G is a directed graph that can be rendered acyclic by removal of at most k nodes}
problemDefinition: Feedback Node Set is solved by removing at most k nodes so that no cycles remain.
inputDescription: G, a directed graph, and k, the maximum number of nodes to remove
outputDescription: True or False, whether removing at most k nodes can make G acyclic
source: Karp, Richard M. Reducibility among combinatorial problems. Complexity of computer computations. Springer, Boston, MA, 1972. 85-103.
certificateFormat: Format: D subset N | at most K nodes, removing D (and incident edges) leaves the graph acyclic Example: {3}

defaultSolver.solverDefinition: This is a brute force solver for the Node Set problem

defaultVerifier.verifierDefinition: This is a verifier for the Node Set problem

defaultVisualization.visualizationDefinition: This is a default visualization for Node Set

solver.solverDefinition: This is a brute force solver for the Node Set problem
